sources.title: Central Bank of Bahrain Rulebook Volume 1 OM-5.5

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

The linked platform publishes the CBB Rulebook; it is not an independent vendor interpretation. Selected local bank duties are used; generic NIST functions in OM-5.5.3 are not relabelled as new Bahrain clauses.
